title: COLLECTION OF WOMAN'S SCARVES
reason: Title omits brands: Oroton scarf legible and a probable Burberrys hang tag with a striped wool scarf, plus silk paisley squares; worth checking labels.
findings: Seven scarves. A camel and mustard wool scarf with navy and white stripes, with a loose white hang tag lying on it printed with small capitals and a small logo mark between two lines; the text is too small to confirm but appears to read BURBERRYS. A plain camel knit scarf with a fringe, a brown plaid woven wool scarf, a dark green, gold and blue paisley square, a red and rust paisley square, an olive and cream square printed OROTON (legible in photo 2), and a pink, orange and black geometric print silk scarf. The title names no brands. The Burberrys tag is loose, no sewn in label was photographed, so authenticity is not verified. No labels seen on the paisley squares.
condition: No stains or holes seen in the photos; creased from storage; fringe on the camel knit scarf slightly tangled.
rescore_note: Oroton square is legible and the loose tag looks like a Burberrys hang tag, but no sewn-in label is shown on the striped scarf, so a genuine Burberrys is only a maybe; the rest are unbranded wool and silk squares, so a mixed lot in the 3-4 band with some upside.
